title: Venky on Goodreads: 'a hard hitting, genuine and iconoclastic handbook'
summary: Established Goodreads reviewer Venky publishes a substantive 4-star advance review of Incorruptible from his NetGalley copy.
blockquote: Incorruptible is a hard hitting, genuine and iconoclastic handbook hoping to usher in a tectonic shift in organisational culture, management, and operations. While not a singularly new concept, it is a curated distillation of unconventional yet productive practices that have been the hallmark of a handful of organisations marking themselves for preservation in perpetuity!
